integrity_audit.method: Exact chapter heading order; integrated bodies compared after ignoring whitespace and the merged-file-only Markdown horizontal-rule separators. Source Markdown bytes remain unmodified.

corpus.raw_input_policy: Read-only. Original chapter files were not copied, rewritten, normalized, or edited.
corpus.stable_id_policy: chapter_id uses source filename ordinal; paragraph_id uses chapter_id and ordinal within that immutable source file. Source SHA and byte offsets independently detect drift.

extraction.extraction_method: Deterministic exact gazetteer/alias dictionary matching and paragraph trigger rules. No model/API inference was run.
extraction.interpretation_limit: Names and events are text-grounded candidate records, not human-validated entity resolution, historical geocoding, event segmentation, or historical fact claims.

geocoding.historic_crs_statement: ASSUMED_EPSG4326; source provides X/Y values but does not establish datum in this table.

modern.crs: EPSG:4326 (GeoJSON coordinates interpreted as longitude/latitude; source has no explicit CRS member).
modern.name_policy: Chinese names are read from ModernChinaCountyTable.csv by administrative code; GeoJSON NAME_CH is ignored because it is mojibake.

name_disambiguation.rule: unique modal exact Chinese name among non-History Data rows; tied mode excluded

modern.alias_policy: All nonempty PROV_CH/PCODE, CITY_CH/DCODE, and COUNTY_CH/CODE2020 source names are attached by code regardless of NOTE, together with nonempty output of the supplied official modern normalizer. Generic administrative labels (市区/市辖区/辖区) are excluded from aliases. No inferred names are added; conflicting source names remain multiple aliases.
modern.history_data_alias_policy: History Data rows are included only as source-evidenced aliases by the codes present in those rows; NOTE does not create a name or change geometry.

historic.level_method: Use the supplied row-level County/Prefecture/Province annotation; numeric LEVEL is hierarchy depth, not administrative level. Unknown/Town/Dynasty/ambiguous labels are excluded.

neighbors.geometry_policy: All finite in-range source OBJ_TYPE=POINT rows; level, name-class, and annotation filters do not apply.

raw_year_zero_values.policy: 0 is retained as a source year; no sentinel meaning is assumed.

historic.crs: ASSUMED_EPSG4326; source provides X/Y values but does not establish datum in this table.
historic.geometry_policy: Only source OBJ_TYPE=POINT records become point geometries; source polygons are not reconstructed from a point coordinate.

source_population.geometry_policy: All finite in-range source OBJ_TYPE=POINT rows; level, name-class, and annotation filters do not apply.

gazetteer_metadata.predictions_and_labels: Gazetteer inputs contain no labels or LLM predictions; human labels and predictions stay in separate output layers.

geocoding.method: RuntimeGeocoder.geocode_rows on exact-name references derived from corpus occurrences; no model/API call; names with non-unique results remain unresolved.

spatial_analysis.method: All analyses consume exact-name outputs and paragraph-level event candidates from the supplied novel; only unique successful coordinates enter mapped features.
spatial_analysis.crs_source: WGS84 lon/lat as supplied by the His-Geo adapter; historic CHGIS datum is upstream-marked ASSUMED_EPSG4326.
spatial_analysis.track_semantics: source co-mention order and straight-line display only; no historical road network was supplied.
spatial_analysis.buffer_site_selection: Use specified Red Cliffs/Guandu/Yiling names only when exact historic-gazetteer-only screening yields a unique coordinate; otherwise use the three most frequently co-mentioned unique historic-gazetteer candidates in war-trigger paragraphs and record them as fallback candidates.

kde.kernel: isotropic Gaussian, truncated at 3 bandwidths; event points equally weighted
kde.area_note: Albers equal-area grid supports comparable cell areas; projected Euclidean distances remain an approximation and are not a route or historical battlefield extent.

spatial_analysis.spatial_join_method_for_buffers: WGS84 ellipsoidal Geod.inv distances to event candidate points; buffer polygon generated in local AEQD metres.
spatial_analysis.historical_interpretation: All mapped results are literary-text candidates. The layers do not establish real battle locations or historical event frequencies.

models_or_paid_api.reason: No explicit text-model inference was authorized for this task; deterministic extraction is used.
